subject: Acceleron renewal — terms, credit & SLA add-on (exec approval requested)
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acceleron.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acceleron renewal — request for terms and SLA

Hi Priyom,

We’re coming up on our 12/31 renewal and the exec team asked me to see what flexibility you have on two items before they sign: a one-time credit to offset the platform migration work we incurred this year, and an SLA add-on (financially-backed availability target) for our production workload.

Baseline: current plan is 600k tokens/month, 12-month renewal.
Ask: 25% one-time credit on first invoice, and SLA 99.9% with a 10% service credit for any monthly availability breach.

Can you let me know what options Redwood can offer? If helpful we can hop on a quick call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of AI Platform
Acceleron Inc.

Attachment: migration_summary.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acceleron.com>

Subject: Re: Acceleron renewal — request for terms and SLA

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and context. I can run a proposal with both items but will need short internal approvals for the credit + SLA. Two quick notes before I pull together numbers:

- Can you confirm target ARR / committed spend for the renewal? (I have the historical usage but need the commit assumption.)
- Are you open to a 12-month term reset with the credit applied as a one-time invoice item, or do you want a shorter term?

If you’re free tomorrow at 11 am PT I’ll bring a commercial option and timeline.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Acceleron renewal — request for terms and SLA (escalation for exec approval)

Team — forwarding Acceleron’s ask. I’d like to propose a concession package to save the renewal but need exec sign-off. Summary and recommended commercial below.

--- Original message from Sarah Liu attached above ---

Why this matters:
- Acceleron is strategic (AI platform partner, potential upsell into private deployments).
- At-risk renewal: they sign late (end of month) and legal cadence is tight; a delayed decision increases churn risk.

Customer asks:
1) One-time credit to offset migration cost: requested 25% of first invoice.
2) SLA add-on: 99.9% availability with financial credits (10% of monthly invoice on breach).

My recommended concession package (commercial):
- One-time credit = 15% of first invoice (capped at $120,000) applied on invoice 1.
- Term reset to 12 months (effective on renewal signing) — customer wants predictability.
- SLA addendum: offer 99.9% availability for production route only, with 5% monthly service credit for qualifying breach. SLA governed by addendum and requires Legal approval.
- Include a 60-day technical onboarding credit (one-time) to cover migration debugging support (equivalent to $10k services credit).

Rationale: This splits the gap between their ask and our cost exposure, preserves margin at scale, and gives the customer a visible uptime commitment without exposing us to open-ended credit risk. The cap on the one-time credit is important.

Attachments: pricing_workup.xlsx (breakdown of impact), sla_addendum_draft.docx, acceleron_proposal_v3.pdf

Ask: Exec approval for the above package (credit cap + SLA addendum as drafted). Legal will need to review SLA language for exposure.

If approved I will: update proposal, loop Legal, and schedule an expedited signature runway (DocuSign link) to close before 12/31.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Acceleron — request for signoff on concession package

Marissa — quick note to escalate for exec signoff. I’ve reviewed Priyom’s recommended package. Summary and risk assessment: 

Recommended grant:
- One-time credit: 15% of invoice 1, capped at $120,000
- Term reset to 12 months (standard renewal term)
- SLA add-on: 99.9% availability on the signed production route, with 5% monthly credit on qualifying breach; Legal to finalize wording.
- One-time onboarding/support credit: $10k services credit.

Risk:
- Precedent: this is a meaningful concession for a mid-market account; we should flag to Sales Ops for booking rules (don’t make these public).
- Legal exposure: the SLA credit and scope must be limited to clearly defined endpoints and monitoring to avoid broad availability disputes.

Why approve:
- Strategic partner with cross-sell potential to Redwood Private.
- Risk of losing the contract if we go back with a 0% credit; likely churn or prolonged negotiation.
- The financial impact is manageable (cap and one-off).

Request: Marissa — can you approve the package (credit capped at $120k + SLA addendum with Legal sign-off)? If you want a counter, suggest the cap or reduce SLA credit to 3%.

I’ve attached the pricing workup and a redlined SLA addendum. If you approve I’ll: 1) send updated proposal to Acceleron, 2) loop Legal and Sales Ops, 3) prepare DocuSign with expedited signature window.

Thanks,
Laura
VP, Revenue Operations

Thanks for the clear summary, team. I’ll approve the package with one adjustment and one administrative requirement: 

Approval (conditional):
- Approve one-time credit = 15% of invoice 1, capped at $120,000.
- Approve term reset to 12 months.
- Approve SLA addendum as drafted but reduce the service credit to 3% monthly on qualifying breach (not 5%).
- Approve $10k onboarding support credit.

Conditions:
1) Legal must sign off on the SLA addendum language and the monitoring/measurement methodology must be unambiguous (SRE/metrics tie-in).
2) Sales Ops to tag the deal as a “concession – exec-approved” in CRM and confirm non-repeatable status.
3) Finance to confirm accounting treatment of one-time credit and that revenue recognition is handled correctly.

Priyom — please:
- Update the proposal to reflect the adjusted SLA credit (3%) and the $120k cap.
- Attach the redlined SLA addendum and loop Legal (cc’ing legal@redwood.com).
- Push DocuSign with a 10-business-day signing window and mark the opportunity as exec-approved in HubSpot (link above).

Once Legal confirms wording I’m comfortable closing. Good work on keeping the cap.

Marissa
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
